verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَيُّوبُ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
verses.web: Then Job answered,

verses.ar: «حَتَّى مَتَى تُعَذِّبُونَ نَفْسِي وَتَسْحَقُونَنِي بِٱلْكَلَامِ؟
verses.kjv: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.web: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

verses.ar: هَذِهِ عَشَرَ مَرَّاتٍ أَخْزَيْتُمُونِي. لَمْ تَخْجَلُوا مِنْ أَنْ تَحْكِرُونِي.
verses.kjv: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed [that] ye make yourselves strange to me.
verses.web: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

verses.ar: وَهَبْنِي ضَلَلْتُ حَقًّا. عَلَيَّ تَسْتَقِرُّ ضَلَالَتِي!
verses.kjv: And be it indeed [that] I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.web: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُمْ بِٱلْحَقِّ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَلَيَّ، فَثَبِّتُوا عَلَيَّ عَارِي.
verses.kjv: If indeed ye will magnify [yourselves] against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.web: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

verses.ar: فَٱعْلَمُوا إِذًا أَنَّ ٱللهَ قَدْ عَوَّجَنِي، وَلَفَّ عَلَيَّ أُحْبُولَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.web: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

verses.ar: هَا إِنِّي أَصْرُخُ ظُلْمًا فَلَا أُسْتَجَابُ. أَدْعُو وَلَيْسَ حُكْمٌ.
verses.kjv: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but [there is] no judgment.
verses.web: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

verses.ar: قَدْ حَوَّطَ طَرِيقِي فَلَا أَعْبُرُ، وَعَلَى سُبُلِي جَعَلَ ظَلَامًا.
verses.kjv: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.web: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

verses.ar: أَزَالَ عَنِّي كَرَامَتِي وَنَزَعَ تَاجَ رَأْسِي.
verses.kjv: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown [from] my head.
verses.web: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

verses.ar: هَدَمَنِي مِنْ كُلِّ جِهَةٍ فَذَهَبْتُ، وَقَلَعَ مِثْلَ شَجَرَةٍ رَجَائِي،
verses.kjv: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.web: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

verses.ar: وَأَضْرَمَ عَلَيَّ غَضَبَهُ، وَحَسِبَنِي كَأَعْدَائِهِ.
verses.kjv: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as [one of] his enemies.
verses.web: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

verses.ar: مَعًا جَاءَتْ غُزَاتُهُ، وَأَعَدُّوا عَلَيَّ طَرِيقَهُمْ، وَحَلُّوا حَوْلَ خَيْمَتِي.
verses.kjv: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.web: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

verses.ar: قَدْ أَبْعَدَ عَنِّي إِخْوَتِي، وَمَعَارِفِي زَاغُوا عَنِّي.
verses.kjv: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.web: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

verses.ar: أَقَارِبِي قَدْ خَذَلُونِي، وَٱلَّذِينَ عَرَفُونِي نَسُونِي.
verses.kjv: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.web: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

verses.ar: نُزَلَاءُ بَيْتِي وَإِمَائِي يَحْسِبُونَنِي أَجْنَبِيًّا. صِرْتُ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ غَرِيبًا.
verses.kjv: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.web: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

verses.ar: عَبْدِي دَعَوْتُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْ. بِفَمِي تَضَرَّعْتُ إِلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: I called my servant, and he gave [me] no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.web: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

verses.ar: نَكْهَتِي مَكْرُوهَةٌ عِنْدَ ٱمْرَأَتِي، وَخَمَمْتُ عِنْدَ أَبْنَاءِ أَحْشَائِي.
verses.kjv: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s [sake] of mine own body.
verses.web: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

verses.ar: اَلْأَوْلَادُ أَيْضًا قَدْ رَذَلُونِي. إِذَا قُمْتُ يَتَكَلَّمُونَ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.web: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

verses.ar: كَرِهَنِي كُلُّ رِجَالِي، وَٱلَّذِينَ أَحْبَبْتُهُمُ ٱنْقَلَبُوا عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.web: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

verses.ar: عَظْمِي قَدْ لَصِقَ بِجِلْدِي وَلَحْمِي، وَنَجَوْتُ بِجِلْدِ أَسْنَانِي.
verses.kjv: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.web: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

verses.ar: تَرَاءَفُوا، تَرَاءَفُوا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيَّ يَا أَصْحَابِي، لِأَنَّ يَدَ ٱللهِ قَدْ مَسَّتْنِي.
verses.kjv: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.web: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا تُطَارِدُونَنِي كَمَا ٱللهُ، وَلَا تَشْبَعُونَ مِنْ لَحْمِي؟
verses.kjv: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.web: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

verses.ar: «لَيْتَ كَلِمَاتِي ٱلْآنَ تُكْتَبُ. يَا لَيْتَهَا رُسِمَتْ فِي سِفْرٍ،
verses.kjv: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.web: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

verses.ar: وَنُقِرَتْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ فِي ٱلصَّخْرِ بِقَلَمِ حَدِيدٍ وَبِرَصَاصٍ.
verses.kjv: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.web: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ وَلِيِّي حَيٌّ، وَٱلْآخِرَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَقُومُ،
verses.kjv: For I know [that] my redeemer liveth, and [that] he shall stand at the latter [day] upon the earth:
verses.web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

verses.ar: وَبَعْدَ أَنْ يُفْنَى جِلْدِي هَذَا، وَبِدُونِ جَسَدِي أَرَى ٱللهَ.
verses.kjv: And [though] after my skin [worms] destroy this [body], yet in my flesh shall I see God:
verses.web: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي أَرَاهُ أَنَا لِنَفْسِي، وَعَيْنَايَ تَنْظُرَانِ وَلَيْسَ آخَرُ. إِلَى ذَلِكَ تَتُوقُ كُلْيَتَايَ فِي جَوْفِي.
verses.kjv: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; [though] my reins be consumed within me.
verses.web: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّكُمْ تَقُولُونَ: لِمَاذَا نُطَارِدُهُ؟ وَٱلْكَلَامُ ٱلْأَصْلِيُّ يُوجَدُ عِنْدِي.
verses.kjv: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.web: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

verses.ar: خَافُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ مِنَ ٱلسَّيْفِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْغَيْظَ مِنْ آثَامِ ٱلسَّيْفِ. لِكَيْ تَعْلَمُوا مَا هُوَ ٱلْقَضَاءُ».
verses.kjv: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath [bringeth] the punishments of the sword, that ye may know [there is] a judgment.
verses.web: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
